deep_dive.title: Harnessing Intrinsic Subject-Aware Attention for Controllable Multi-Subject Video Generation
deep_dive.abstract: Multi-subject video generation faces two key challenges: uncontrollable fidelity strength and potential semantic drift. We address these by analyzing the internal mechanisms of Diffusion Transformers (DiTs). We found that certain attention blocks naturally form an Intrinsic Spatial Grounding Map (ISGM) that precisely locates reference subjects. Building on this insight, we propose Dual-phase Intrinsic Attention Leveraging (DIAL), a framework that uses these internal signals for both training and inference. In low-noise stages, we use ISGM to guide the attention mechanism, allowing precise control over fidelity strength during inference without retraining. In high-noise stages, we use these same maps to automatically build preference pairs at no additional cost for Reinforcement Learning (RL). This RL procedure effectively anchors the model's attention to reference subjects and mitigates semantic drift. Extensive experiments show that DIAL significantly outperforms baseline models on the OpenS2V-Eval benchmark, consistently improving identity consistency and enabling controllable fidelity strength.

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: This paper proposes DIAL, which exploits intrinsic spatial grounding maps in Diffusion Transformers to enable controllable multi-subject video generation without retraining.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 多主体视频生成面临保真度强度不可控与语义漂移两大难题。作者通过分析扩散Transformer的内部机制，发现某些注意力块会自然形成内在空间定位图，可精确定位参考主体，并据此提出双阶段内在注意力利用框架DIAL。该框架在低噪声阶段用定位图引导注意力，实现推理时无需重训练的保真度精确控制；在高噪声阶段利用同一信号自动构建偏好。研究为免训练的多主体视频生成提供了新的内部机制视角与控制手段。
